cases.name: table, schema and function with spaces and quotes
setup: CREATE TABLE "My App"."order items" (id int PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE FUNCTION "My App"."f old"(x int) RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT x + 1 $$
statements: ALTER TABLE "My App"."order items" RENAME TO "it's ""new""";
ALTER FUNCTION "My App"."f old"(integer) RENAME TO "f new";

checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE tablename = 'order items'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'spare 2'

cases.name: table stays in its own database (not the session default)
setup: CREATE TABLE app.`order items` (id int PRIMARY KEY)

cases.name: table and procedure in a schema with a space, names with quotes
setup: CREATE TABLE [My App].[order items] (id int PRIMARY KEY)

statements: EXEC sp_rename N'[My App].[order items]', N'it''s new';
EXEC sp_rename N'[My App].[p old]', N'p''s new';

checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.procedures WHERE name = 'p''s new'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'order items'
